Equip {1} ({1}: Attach to target creature you control. Equip only as a sorcery.)

Canopy Baloth.oracle_text: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, this creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.

Coalborn Entity.oracle_text: {2}{R}: This creature deals 1 damage to target creature token, player, or planeswalker.

Dragon Fodder.oracle_text: Create two 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens.

Dragon Hatchling.oracle_text:
Flying
{R}: This creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.

Dragonspeaker Shaman.oracle_text: Dragon spells you cast cost {2} less to cast.

Evolving Wilds.oracle_text: {T}, Sacrifice this land: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

Fiery Intervention.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Fiery Intervention deals 5 damage to target creature.
• Destroy target artifact.

Garruk's Harbinger.oracle_text:
Hexproof from black
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker, look at that many cards from the top of your library. You may reveal a creature card or Garruk planeswalker card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

Garruk's Uprising.oracle_text:
When this enchantment enters, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, draw a card.
Creatures you control have trample. (Each of those creatures can deal excess combat damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.)
Whenever a creature you control with power 4 or greater enters, draw a card.

Goblin Researcher.oracle_text: When this creature enters, exile the top card of your library. During any turn you attacked with this creature, you may play that card.

Hellkite Punisher.oracle_text:
Flying
{R}: This creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.

Khalni Heart Expedition.oracle_text:
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you may put a quest counter on this enchantment.
Remove three quest counters from this enchantment and sacrifice it: Search your library for up to two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

Lightning Shrieker.oracle_text:
Flying, trample, haste
At the beginning of the end step, this creature's owner shuffles it into their library.

Pillar of Flame.oracle_text: Pillar of Flame deals 2 damage to any target. If a creature dealt damage this way would die this turn, exile it instead.

Rampaging Growth.oracle_text: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle. Until end of turn, that land becomes a 4/3 Insect creature with reach and haste. It's still a land.

Terror of the Peaks.oracle_text:
Flying
Spells your opponents cast that target this creature cost an additional 3 life to cast.
Whenever another creature you control enters, this creature deals damage equal to that creature's power to any target.

Thrill of Possibility.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card.
Draw two cards.

Wildfire Elemental.oracle_text: Whenever an opponent is dealt noncombat damage, creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.

annotations.description: Used Pillar of Flame to deal 2 damage to the opponent's face on turn 2 with no creatures on board. Pillar of Flame is valuable removal that could exile a creature later. The 2 face damage is low-impact, while the player's hand is relatively slow and lacks other interaction.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Pillar of Flame targeting opponent for 2 face damage on turn 2
annotations.betterLine: Pass and save Pillar of Flame for removing an opponent's creature later. The hand has no other removal, and spending it for 2 face damage is inefficient when the game plan involves deploying Dragonspeaker Shaman and expensive dragons.

annotations.description: Equipped Adventuring Gear to Rumbling Baloth instead of Garruk's Harbinger. With the opponent tapped out and Wildfire Elemental summoning sick, both creatures attack unblocked. Harbinger's trigger lets you look at cards equal to combat damage dealt — equipping it maximizes card selection (looking at 6 cards instead of 4 unequipped). Baloth has no combat damage trigger, so the +2/+2 is wasted value compared to putting it on Harbinger.
annotations.actionTaken: Chose Rumbling Baloth as the equip target for Adventuring Gear
annotations.betterLine: Equip Adventuring Gear to Garruk's Harbinger, then play Evolving Wilds for landfall, making Harbinger a 6/5 trampler that looks at 6 cards on combat damage

annotations.description: Cast Rampaging Growth while Adventuring Gear's equip ability is still on the stack targeting Rumbling Baloth. The land from Rampaging Growth enters before the equipment is attached, wasting a +2/+2 landfall trigger on Baloth. With the opponent at 12 life, this 2 extra damage matters.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Rampaging Growth before letting the Equip ability resolve, causing the land to enter without triggering Adventuring Gear's landfall.
annotations.betterLine: Let the Equip resolve first (attaching Gear to Baloth), then play Evolving Wilds (landfall +2/+2), crack it for a Forest (landfall +2/+2), then cast Rampaging Growth (landfall +2/+2) for a total of +6/+6 on Baloth before attacking.

annotations.description: Equipped Adventuring Gear to the animated Forest (temporary creature from Rampaging Growth) instead of Garruk's Harbinger. While lethal is likely either way with landfall triggers from Evolving Wilds, if combat doesn't go as planned, the equipment becomes stranded on a non-creature permanent. Garruk's Harbinger is a permanent creature with a combat damage trigger that scales with power, making it the superior equipment target.
annotations.actionTaken: Equipped Adventuring Gear to the animated Forest 4/3
annotations.betterLine: Equip Adventuring Gear to Garruk's Harbinger, which is a permanent creature with hexproof from black and a combat damage trigger that benefits from higher power.

annotations.description: Blocking the Forest 4/3 instead of Garruk's Harbinger results in the same 11 total trample damage (surviving at 1 life either way), but allows Garruk's Harbinger to connect unblocked for 4 combat damage, triggering its ability to look at 4 cards from the top of the library. Blocking Harbinger instead would limit it to 1 trample damage and only looking at 1 card.
annotations.actionTaken: Blocked the Forest 4/3 land-creature with Wildfire Elemental
annotations.betterLine: Block Garruk's Harbinger with Wildfire Elemental to minimize the Harbinger's card selection trigger (look at 1 card instead of 4)

annotations.description: The opponent is at 1 life. GPT53C Teach has Garruk's Harbinger (4/3) and Rumbling Baloth (4/4) on the battlefield with trample from Garruk's Uprising. The opponent has only 4 Mountains (2 tapped) and no creatures to block. Any attack would be lethal. Instead of playing a land and attacking, the player passed priority in the precombat main phase, moving toward ending the turn without attacking.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority in precombat main phase with opponent at 1 life and two large creatures ready to attack.
annotations.betterLine: Play a land (Forest or Evolving Wilds for landfall triggers), then move to combat and attack with Garruk's Harbinger and Rumbling Baloth for lethal damage against the opponent at 1 life with no blockers.
